node.label: Subcortical band heterotopia
node.definition: A form of subcortical heterotopia with mislocalized gray matter within the white matter.It is defined as longitudinal bands of gray matter located deep to the cerebral cortex and separated from it by a thin layer of normal appearing white matter. It is part of the lissencephaly spectrum.

diseases.label: cobblestone lissencephaly without muscular or ocular involvement
